data.one_liner: Provides smooth scroll animations for mouse wheel, trackpad, and touch inputs in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Silky Scroll interpolates mouse wheel and trackpad inputs to deliver natural, smooth scroll animations. It includes zero-boilerplate preset widgets like SilkyListView, SilkyGridView, and SilkyCustomScrollView that drop in place of standard Flutter scrollables.
use_when: You want buttery-smooth scrolling on web, desktop, and mobile devices.
You need drop-in replacements for standard scrollable widgets with minimal configuration.
You require advanced mouse wheel behavior like edge locking and horizontal shift-wheel support.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms where standard default scrolling physics are specifically required by design guidelines.
strengths: Automatic input detection for mouse, trackpad, and touch.
Provides convenient preset drop-in widgets matching standard Flutter scrollables.
Configurable animation durations, curves, speed, and overscroll stretch effects.
weaknesses: Adds custom scroll physics and animation layers which may slightly alter standard platform scroll feel if not tuned.
Requires a minimum Flutter version of 3.44.0.
data.minimal_example:
SilkyListView.builder(
  itemCount: 100,
  itemBuilder: (context, i) => ListTile(title: Text('Item $i')),
)
